2 string literals reach the DOM through a name the template binds:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:32: interpolation reads `vm` → "Delete the row"
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:34: interpolation reads `vm` → "Delete the row"
description: A sentence in a map literal an `ngIf` holds, read by `as vm` and by the implicit `let-vm` (measured: drawn twice). A map that writes no key a variable reads is no context but a value, taken whole where the variable reads the binding's name or the implicit value, so the refusal counts two.
